_description: Spider Core 能力注册表 — 记录所有 Core 模块、候选模块、Domain Packs

logger.description: 共享日志引擎 + domain-aware routing — log_event(domain, msg) 自动分流到 logs/{domain}/YYYY-MM-DD.log，log() 保持向后兼容

signature.log: (msg: str, log_dir: Path | None = None) -> None
signature.log_event: (domain: str, msg: str, base_dir: Path | None = None) -> None

structured_logger.description: 结构化日志引擎 — 基于 structlog，SpiderLogger(domain) 输出彩色控制台 + JSONL 文件，支持 stage/task/status/runtime/score/source 等结构化字段，与 core/logger.py 并存

signature.SpiderLogger: (domain: str, base_dir: Path | None = None) -> SpiderLogger

network_wait.description: 基于 socket 的网络可用性检查，带超时和重试

windows_utils.description: Windows 特定工具 — PATH 修复 + Claudian 配置读取

scoring.description: 共享评分引擎 — 5 维度（信源权威/时效性/社区热度/用户相关/长期价值）+ breakdown 输出 + 推荐原因 + 事件级去重

signature.filter_low_quality: (items: list, patterns: list | None = None) -> list

markdown_writer.description: 共享报告引擎 — domain-aware routing 自动分流到 reports/{domain}/YYYY-MM-DD-{type}.md，支持 YAML frontmatter、原子写入、自动备份。与 logs 结构保持对称

signature.ReportWriter: (domain: str, base_dir: Path | None = None) -> ReportWriter
signature.write: (content: str, report_type: str = 'ai', date_str: str | None = None) -> Path
signature.write_report: (domain: str, content: str, report_type: str = 'ai', base_dir: Path | None = None, frontmatter: dict | None = None) -> Path

health_writer.description: 共享健康/可观测性写入器 — domain-aware routing 到 health/{domain}/YYYY-MM-DD-health.json，结构化 JSON 输出，支持 source_status、pipeline 摘要、extensible extra 字段（retry/telemetry/orchestration/trend_memory 预留）

signature.HealthWriter: (domain: str, base_dir: Path | None = None) -> HealthWriter
signature.set_source_status: (name: str, status: str, items: int = 0, error: str = '', **extra) -> None
signature.write_health: (domain: str, base_dir: Path | None = None, source_status: list[dict] | None = None, pipeline: dict | None = None, extra: dict | None = None, date_str: str | None = None) -> Path

trend_memory.description: Domain-local 增量趋势记忆 — 追踪 recurring topics / entities / themes 的频率变化，自动计算 rising/stable/declining 趋势方向，输出 trend_signals_for_prompt() 注入日报。轻量设计：只存关键词+频率，不存全文

signature.TrendMemory: (domain: str, base_dir: Path | None = None) -> TrendMemory
signature.update: (keywords: list[str], entities: list[str], themes: list[str], date_str: str | None) -> None

redis_dedup.description: Redis-backed two-layer dedup: URL Bloom filter + SimHash fuzzy dedup (Hamming <= 3) with 4-block index. Supports graceful degradation when Redis is down.

signature.RedisDedupPipeline: (redis_url: str, key_prefix: str, logger: SpiderLogger | None, fallback_permissive: bool) -> RedisDedupPipeline

redis_dedup.notes: Starts as candidate per lifecycle rules. Promote to stable after 2+ projects adopt it. Redis Stack's BF.ADD/BF.EXISTS could replace the manual bloom implementation.
